analogy.rationale: Uricosuric blockers act on organic anion transporters (SLC22A6/8/11/12, SLCO1C1) and PANX1, which are poorly expressed or not coupled to transcriptional programs in these cell lines, so little mRNA response is expected; the closest analogs are other transporter/channel modulators with similarly limited transcriptional footprints.
